purpose: Represents a person or entity as a photo, initials or an icon, with an optional selection ring and presence dot. Use one size per context.

notFor.case: A decorative icon tile in a card or empty state.
A photo or illustration as content.

Default.meaning: Static; Type, Variant and Appearance set the look (a photo has no colour variants).
Default.visual: Surface/muted base with a Border/subtle edge; initials and icon in the variant's roles (soft secondary: Surface/muted with Content/secondary; solid default: Action/primary/default with Content/on-action; status: Status/<severity>/surface or surface-solid). The ring, when shown, is Border/accent.

a11y.role: img with an accessible name (aria-label, or the photo's alt); aria-hidden when decorative
notes: The presence dot is announced as text, not by colour.

openQuestions: What shows when the photo fails to load: initials, the icon, or the muted base? The contract does not say.
The ring (RingVisible) marks selection, but Avatar is not focusable. What makes an avatar selectable, and who announces it?
